svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or kyletouchet.dev. Q: any GitHub stats? 1,539 contributions, 6 mo, 108 active days, 19 days, best streak, 142 on the busiest day This week so far: 75 contributions and 0 pull request events. Q: has Sand actually built with AI? Plenty. Hands-on with models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI, plus DeepSeek, Hugging Face, Replicate, Ollama and llama.cpp. Real-time voice interfaces, like LadderStar's voice-to-voice audition room Multi-agent orchestration, tool calling and the Model Context Protocol RAG, prompt and context engineering, and evaluations Q: hold on, airship mods? Two published mods for Create: Aeronautics, on CurseForge and Modrinth: procedural delivery contracts with physics-compiled cargo, and a preflight tool that simulates…
